exclude.why: wrong key: 15% but standard fact is one-tenth (10%) of total members (Art 100(3))
wrong key: 'the first hour of the Session' but standard fact is the time immediately following Question Hour
wrong key: 'Question-answer session' (that is Question Hour) but standard fact is Zero Hour = time after Question Hour for urgent matters without prior notice
wrong key: returning a financial bill, but standard fact is the President can return Financial Bills I and II; only a Money Bill cannot be returned (Art 111)
